Name: Alphaeus
Summary: Alphaeus was the father of the apostle James son of Alphaeus, and, by Mark's account, of Levi the tax collector who became the apostle Matthew. He is named only through his sons.
KeyStory: Alphaeus is known only as the father of two apostles, James and Levi, called from very different lives.
LifeLesson: A father can be remembered for the sons God called. Alphaeus raised two men Jesus chose.
